title: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 11 A Time Of Defamation

sense.text:
America says freedom of religion; that is a lie. They say you are free to serve whatever: you can be a Muslim, a Christian, a Catholic, an Adventist, serving garbage. The Muslim says our God's name is Allah, you have Krishna, you have Buddha; in reality everybody is serving the same God. The proof: it doesn't matter what religion you are, when Christmas comes everybody is saying Merry Christmas. I thought you were a Muslim? Or if they try to get smart, happy holidays: same thing. They are all worshipping the same thing; they are worshipping the beast, like in Babylon when the king said everybody has to bow down.

“Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God,” This is read so you brothers can see what we are facing. This is not going to be a walk in the park; nobody goes to war thinking it is a walk in the park; there are going to be casualties, and this is spiritual warfare, not knives and guns. You are at war to wake up your people, to change the mind of the black man in America and all over the world, to save the soul of our people. Esau, the enemy, is not going to take it lying down after spending billions of dollars over 400 years to keep you stupid; now you are waking up, they are coming after you, making up laws and making up things so they can come after you. That is the type of war you are in.

Casting down imaginations: you might imagine Jesus Christ is white; as leaders we have to cast that down. You might imagine the Sabbath is in the morning; we have to cast that garbage down. You might imagine I'm going to eat fish for Passover, buy a box of Popeyes chicken; we have to cast that down. As leaders that is your job, and it is not over yet: there is going to be a lot more doctrine come, as Paul said those things must come to pass, and it is going to be brothers and sisters sitting right next to you. Some of you think you are in la-la land and everything is going to be fine; your trial and tribulation is coming. Remember us in Egypt: we became so low we started to serve an animal as a god, an animal you can kill. It is the same thing in America: God says lamb, the brother says chicken; God says goat, the brother says chicken. That dude said you don't have to do the Day of Atonement; the Day of Atonement, is that good or bad? It's good for you, so why tell me not to do it? They don't want you to see the light, and you follow because you move by emotion and feeling, not by laws: he's a good teacher, I love the brother. The brother is a damn ashy black devil; that is what he is going to die like. When you are caught up in your feelings and emotion, what happens next? Death. The holy days mean days separated from other days, each with its own spirit; a foolish man tells you to change what you do on the holy days and you don't see the devil coming for you. Don't come to the feast days, the Passover, the new moon with a sad face; get up and do a little dance for the Lord. Sister, you are going to die with depression.

This right here is your job description; this is why we have been sent here. Sisters too: you have to cast these imaginations down in here as well. A lot of times you see the brother or sister next to you starting to malfunction and you say nothing, because you are non-confrontational, you don't want to ruffle feathers, you want someone else to do it. No: that is a symptom, he's tripping, and you could have stopped it right there: hey bro, that ain't what the scripture is talking about. It takes believing brothers and sisters to stop the nonsense in its tracks. There was a flat earth situation: people who were in the Navy, who travelled around the world and didn't fall off the side, now think the earth is flat; they say we teleported. Because you don't want to be that person, that nonsense grows and festers, and now two or three people in here think the earth might be flat. The point is not the earth being flat; it is the demonic spirit that comes with that doctrine. Froward thoughts separate from God (Wisdom of Solomon 1:3): when you hear things separating from the Bible, unbiblical, stomp it right in its tracks; be that backbone. If you don't check it you will see the spirit leaving that person slowly, and next thing they are eating pancakes and bacon and eggs for the Passover. You are watchmen; your job description is right there in 2 Corinthians 10:5: cast down any nonsense that comes out, throw it to the ground violently, not literally. Don't play with it; not for an hour; we are not going to sit and argue with you. When you catch cancer early you have a better chance, but you let these brothers get to stage four. Be responsible. Walk outside, look up at the moon and ask him about that curvature; he'll say I'll get back to you and go Google some stuff. A good understanding have all they that do his commandments. When we witness evil in our presence and don't immediately stomp it out, it sends a message that the gospel we hold is not worth fighting for; that small piece of leaven, that small seed of evil, will destroy everything we are building. Let us take heed to the gospel we have been taught, lest at any time we let it slip (Hebrews 2:1). Like on your job: the minute you do anything against the company's policies you are dealt with immediately, because they see that small infraction as a detriment to the whole company. That is the seriousness in making sure things stay on course.

precepts.why:
“For froward thoughts separate from God:” You will always see it; even the person that is bugging, in the early phases of bugging, feels it, because they know what they are saying doesn't sound right, but it feels good, and they don't really have a scripture for it. Froward thoughts separate from the Most High. You have to be that brother and sister when you start hearing these things that are separating from the Bible, that are unbiblical, that ain't according to the scripture: stomp it right in its tracks. You have to be that backbone: if I don't say nothing, nobody will. If every person in here had that thought process we would be straight; these doctrines would get crushed. But because folks are like, I'm not really like that, these things happen.

“and his power, when it is tried, reproveth the unwise. For into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject unto sin.” You will start to see, because you don't want to check it, the understanding and the spirit leaving that person slowly; next thing you know they are up here talking about we are eating pancakes and bacon and eggs for the Passover. In the world, around Passover it is bake all you can bake, pastries everywhere; you are doing the same thing as the world. If we don't check it, brothers and sisters, it will destroy you. You are watchmen; your job description is in 2 Corinthians 10:5. Cast down any imagination, any nonsense that comes out; throw it to the ground violently, not literally, but don't play with it.

sense.text:
“Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven:” Brothers, you say you are leaders: who is Christ talking to here? He is talking to his disciples, the leaders. Christ said to the leaders, whatever you bind on earth is bound in heaven. That is some power right there; some of you don't understand what Christ just said. A brother comes to you: Deacon, Captain, I like that sister over there; you say no. You know what you just did? You just bound that on earth. When he goes behind your back and marries her, that is why he has problems, because you never blessed it. Remember when Paul said of that brother in Corinth, give him to Satan? When you see the brother walk out of here, we give him to Satan. That is why now he is changing all the doctrine, his mind all bugged out. Every single person that left, who was in the street teaching every week: as soon as they leave they are never back in the street. That brother is bound on earth. Once you give him to Satan, Satan has that brother, and Satan has him saying you can eat chicken, the Sabbath is morning to morning; he is doing the work of Satan, and some of you follow him.

What does the word whatsoever mean? Anything. Anything your leaders, your prophets don't bless, the Most High says I'm not blessing it either. You bound it on earth, it is bound in heaven. That is what Christ, the black Messiah, said; we didn't make that up. That is the power God gave to his prophets, to the men of God. Remember the scripture about the wife's vow: if her husband hears it and disallows it, God disallows it; it is the same thing. That is why when the brothers and sisters leave, what happened to so-and-so? Nothing; they do nothing. In all this time there has not been one person that left who is still going into the street and teaching every Saturday.

“and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.” Since we have a lot of leaders in the house today: what does it mean to be a leader? That camp you are over is not your camp. Some of you say I built this; no, you ain't built nothing, the Most High used you to build this. Brothers do classes online with 300 or 400 people in the class and think these people are in the class because of me. No: those are not your people, those are the people of the Most High; they are following the Most High. If you think if I leave all these people online are going to follow me, you are totally mistaken; ask the people that left before you. A brother used to have a thousand viewers and thought they were there for him, look how well I can teach, I can pronounce words well; no, those people didn't come into the truth because you can teach well, they came because the Most High God called them.

precepts.why:
We are servants; God's son Jesus was a servant, and if we are following Christ that makes us servants. Some of you think you are almighty; no, brother, you are here to serve, that is your job. Put it perfectly: the deacon is here to make the bishop look good, the captain is here to make the deacons look good, the officers are here to make the captains look good, and so on. That is called unity, that is called leadership, that is called government.

“And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.” Everybody wants to be the chief, nobody wants to be the Indian; everybody wants to be chief but nobody wants to serve. I want the title, but I don't want to live up to the title; I just want to tell men what to do. Brothers, as leaders, if you are not ready to pick up the mop and mop the floor, you should not expect another brother to do it either, because it starts with you. A great leader raises men to be better leaders than himself; do not try to keep the brother down; you are supposed to build that brother up to be better than you; if that brother is not better than you, something is wrong.

A brother said this officer teaches better than this captain, this captain teaches better than the bishop, than the deacon. You are crazy. In Esau's world every one of us went to school to learn from a teacher, a professor. You woke up one day and said I'm better than this professor? You can go on YouTube right now and learn how to do surgery, but you are not going to let me perform on you; the first thing you'll say is, Deacon, what is your qualification, what school did you go to? Take some common sense. If you say the deacon is a good teacher, guess what: the Bishop is better. If my captains are good teachers, I am better than them; if the officers teach better than the captain, no, the captain is better, because they are learning from the higher rank. You think Peter was greater than Christ? You're an idiot. Those are common sense. That is when men start thinking they are beyond themselves: look how I teach. One brother who left said you don't have to watch Deacon so-and-so any more, which one do you want to watch, myself? Where is he at today? Those are foolish thoughts of men who are over themselves, not humbling. This mission is all about humbling, and exalting one another in due time. All those young men remember a few precepts and know how to put them together so the words sound sweet to you, but they don't know what the spirit world requires: the spirit world hates pride; pride and disrespect are not accepted in the spiritual world. Paul said these things are earthly, an earthly doctrine.

And the sister who just came in a year ago and married an officer says I'm an officer's wife and eats before the sister that has been labouring for three, four, five years. Does that make sense? The sister that married the officer of ten is no leader of nothing, but she exalts her power against a sister that lined up for years. What scripture is that? The scripture says let the young women learn from the sisters that were there before them. Hell no; you are not going to pass that. Some congregations say nothing to it: the officer of ten's wife eats and the little sister who has been labouring for years sits in the back. That can hurt somebody's spirit. Everybody has to deserve their name; get your own name, build your own legacy, put your own bricks in; don't ride on my name. Brothers who are leaders: when your wife tries to use your authority to abuse other sisters, hell no, it is not going down like that. Show some respect and honour to those who were there before you. It doesn't matter if she is Deacon so-and-so's wife; she cannot abuse or disrespect you. We are trying to escape looking down upon each other; that is why we are in this captivity in the first place, because we decided not to obey these laws and to live like savages. If you are returning to the Lord you better understand what savage is, what disrespect is, what pride is. We are here to guide you the right way as long as you believe what God said; but you have to be willing to listen and apply it, not only learn precepts.

sense.text: The title of the class is A Time of Defamation, a study of Revelation 11. The apostle John is writing this approximately 96 AD; the series has been going through the entire book of Revelation from back to front. “And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.” The angel is instructing him to measure the temple of God, the altar within, and them that worship therein. It is the same thing that was said to Zechariah: a man with a measuring line to measure Jerusalem, and Jerusalem is a people before it is a place (Zechariah 2:1-8). The Lord is saying to measure Jerusalem, and the ones he is looking for as his elect begin with Judah. He is not interested in the other nations. My great-aunt is... well, sorry for your great-aunt.

“But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles:” Don't measure the outer court. Herod had built an outer court where the Gentiles, the other nations, were able to assemble, monitor and be nosy. God is not dealing with the outer part, the other nations. A lot of you want to bring your friends into this truth, but the part that is given to the Gentiles, don't measure; God is not interested in that. I don't give a damn about them.

“and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.” Forty-two months divided by twelve is three and a half, 350 years: they would destroy Jerusalem and inhabit it. Literally this is going into 70 AD. Look at the Arch of Titus, the Arch of Triumph, where Rome destroyed Jerusalem and took the menorah out; look at the size of the menorah. General Titus and his father Vespasian led the Roman army against us; that is all Edomites carrying our stuff out of the temple. That is what the Lord said is given unto the Gentiles. The Israelites fell by the edge of the sword and were led away captive into all nations, and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled (Luke 21:24): the same thing the Lord is telling John. That forty-two months, 350 years, is a dispensation of time; the Bible uses that terminology several times, like the forty-two months given to the beast (Revelation 13:5), the time given Esau to destroy us.

precepts.why:
Remember that Jerusalem is a people before it is a place. The angel said to rise and measure the temple and them that worship therein, but not the outer court given to the Gentiles. “I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.” This is Zechariah during the time of the Persian captivity. “Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.” The width and the length of Jerusalem. “And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him, And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein: For I, saith the Lord, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.” This is the people being delivered, wherein the Lord is our protector, just like when we came out of ancient Egypt he was a fire by night and a cloud by day.

“Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord:” Zechariah is prophesying through the spirit of the Lord that the Israelites would be delivered from the land of the north; this is prophetic of North America. “for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.” Although we were spread forth as the four winds of heaven, north, south, east and west, he is letting us know that from the land of the north there is going to be a major deliverance: from North America.

“Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” When it talks about the daughter of Zion it is talking about Judah first and foremost. And the daughter of Babylon is Edom: David in the spirit calls Edom the daughter of Babylon (Psalms 137:7-8). So it is letting you know that Judah would live with Edom; Judah would dwell with Edom. You have people saying there are no Israelites here in North America; you are dumb as a rock. That is how you know it is not talking so much about Benjamin: Benjamin is on the islands by themselves, Levi is on the islands, just like Ephraim, and the rest is Judah. That is why people make fun of Judah: we have no place to go; you live here with Esau. We have to dwell with Edom, and that is the prophecy right there.

“For thus saith the Lord of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you:” The Lord is sending Christ after us regarding the nations which spoiled us, because they are going to get destroyed, these nations that touched us. “for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.” When it says we are the apple of his eye, that means we are his favourite, his chosen. He will shake his hand upon them and they shall be a spoil to their servants: the people who have touched us, Edom, are going to be destroyed.

Who is the daughter of Babylon that Zion dwells with? “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem;” This is King David prophesying about Babylon coming and destroying Jerusalem. Edom is the ancient name for the modern Caucasians. “who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” Rase it means destroy it. “O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed;” David in the spirit is calling Edom the daughter of Babylon. “happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.” So Zechariah 2:7, deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon, is letting you know that Judah would dwell with Edom.

The holy city trodden under foot: the Arch of Titus shows Rome carrying the menorah out of the temple, Titus and Vespasian leading the Roman army against us, all Edomites carrying our stuff out. Here is the precept. “And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations:” The Israelites fell by the edge of the sword and were led away captive into all nations: those that stayed behind to fight Rome, those Israelites that thought they could fight Rome; those that weren't killed were captured and led away into slavery. “and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.” That is the same thing the Lord is telling John: don't measure the outer court, for it is given unto the Gentiles, and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months. That forty-two months, 350 years, is a dispensation of time; the Bible uses that terminology several times.

We read this a couple of weeks ago. “And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.” You see that: there is that forty and two months again. That is the time that was given Esau to destroy us.

sense.text:
“And I will give power unto my two witnesses,” Number one, the two witnesses. Write this down: the power is power to rule and dominate. Who are the two witnesses? Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord (Isaiah 43:1, 10): the witnesses are the Israelites, not all nations that believe in Jesus. Why two? Because we were split into two kingdoms, two nations, and they shall be no more two nations (Ezekiel 37:22); the same understanding as Ephesians 2, making of twain one new man. So he is going to give the two kingdoms power. When is this? Look at the timeline: the bottom of verse 2 is 70 AD, the destruction of Jerusalem; then he says I will give power unto my two witnesses. What happened after 70 AD? Rome fell, and after that Israel rose on this side of the world as well as over in the East, during the time of the Dark Ages.

“and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days,” 1,260 divided by 360 is three and a half again. “clothed in sackcloth.” Sackcloth is filthy garments, like Joshua the high priest clothed with filthy garments (Zechariah 3:3-4). Sackcloth is burlap, potato-sack fabric; when we wore sackcloth we were in a state of mourning, dust on our head, clothes ripped. Joshua's filthy garments are the sackcloth: we were still under the curses of God, but he gave us power. So we were prophesying clothed in filthy garments.

“These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.” That is why it was prefaced with Joshua the high priest: I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH, Christ (Zechariah 3:8), and then Zechariah 4 goes into Zerubbabel, the candlestick all of gold and the two olive trees by it, the two anointed ones that stand by the Lord of the whole earth (Zechariah 4:1-14). Just like Christ spoke with Moses and Elijah, Zechariah makes mention of Joshua and Zerubbabel. The two olive trees, the two candlesticks, make reference to Joshua the high priest and Zerubbabel the governor; it goes into the law and the testimony, and it is also symbolic of the two kingdoms. When you follow the precepts they actually represent the two kingdoms and the law and the testimony. It is still making reference to verse 3, the two witnesses, Judah and Israel.

“And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.” This is making reference to the two kingdoms rising up against their enemies. This is about war and destruction, not World War I, but the two witnesses rising against their enemies. We shot flaming arrows; we made war against these nations.

“These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy:” This goes into them living the curses, and also dominating; no rain means no blessings. “and have power over waters to turn them to blood,” When you are at war with people, you kill so many people that the water turns to blood; that is from war. And not only did we poison the waters against our enemies, we were killing their bodies. “and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.” Many times brothers read verses 5 and 6 and that is where the confusion comes in, and the Christian commentaries don't understand what this is talking about. Remember verses 1 and 2 were 70 AD; then it goes into the two witnesses having power. So after the fall these two witnesses received power; Israel got power. If Israel fell in 70 AD, when did they rise up again? That is what verses 4, 5 and 6 are going through.

“And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.” Verse 7 is the key. Who is this beast? A man: that they might see that they themselves are beasts (Ecclesiastes 3:18); a particular man is called a beast, like in Revelation 13. Verses 1 and 2 were the fall of Jerusalem; then the two witnesses got power; now in verse 7 a beast, a man, rises out of the earth to overcome the two kingdoms. You look at these little Christian movies with two old Amalekites running through Jerusalem calling fire down; it ain't talking about that. What is the bottomless pit? Job 30:5-10: a particular race driven forth from among men, chased like they stole something, to dwell in the clifts of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks. This is the Caucasus mountains of Georgia, Russia. This people came out of the bottomless pit and rose up against us; the whole of Job 30 is prophetic of a particular man who now afflicts us. When did this happen? It began in 1453, during the time of the Renaissance, when they rose up against both kingdoms: they got Judah on the east side and Ephraim and them in the Western Hemisphere. Revelation 13:7 says the same thing with different words: it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them. From 1453 you had the Inquisition; they pushed us out of Rome, Constantinople, Spain; many of us fled to Africa, some got captured. 1492, Columbus sent an armada under the orders of King Ferdinand and Queen Isabella, and took soldiers to the Western Hemisphere: why take soldiers with armour if you are just looking for India and spices? Because they were conquering the northern kingdom on this side. They weren't finished with the southern kingdom, then came the transatlantic slave trade, where they made deals with Hamites and Ishmaelites against us. Malachi 1:1-4 is another precept: God laid Esau's mountains and heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness; Edom was impoverished during the Middle Ages, in the clifts of the rocks, but we will return and build the desolate places: the Renaissance, rebirth of the white man in power in the earth; they have been building from 1453 until today, but God said I will throw down, and they shall be called the border of wickedness, the people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever. The beast, the white man that ascended out of the bottomless pit, out of the Caucasus mountains, made war against us, overcame us and killed us; they put us in slavery. The power God gave the two witnesses is not the power like Christ or Moses or Elijah had, although it is worded like that; it is power to rule, because that is what we did as a people: we ruled this earth for over a thousand years, but it wasn't all in righteousness, and that is why God allowed us to be overcome and killed.

precepts.why: Who are the two witnesses? This is the same scripture Jehovah's Witnesses like to use to justify calling themselves Jehovah's Witnesses, but verse 1 tells you who the witnesses are. “But now thus saith the Lord that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.” So it is talking about the Israelites. Then verse 10: ye are my witnesses.

“Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.” Ye are my witnesses: so the witnesses are the Israelites. The witnesses are not all nations that believe in Jesus; understand that thing. The witnesses are Israel, making reference to the two kingdoms.

Why does it say two witnesses? You need to know the history of the Israelites to understand why it uses two. It is the same understanding as Ephesians 2, having made both one, making of twain one new man. “And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations,” They shall be no more two nations; we were split into two kingdoms, two nations. “neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:” So he is going to give the two kingdoms power.

Clothed in sackcloth is referring to filthy garments. When we wore sackcloth we were in a state of mourning: we would put dust on our head and wipe it in our clothes, rip our clothes up, and wear sackcloth, burlap, the potato-sack fabric. “Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel. And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.” When Joshua had on these filthy garments, these dirty clothes, in Revelation that is going into the sackcloth. Why? We were still under the curses of God, but remember, he gave us power. So we are prophesying clothed in filthy garments, and the sackcloth represents iniquity, sin.

Remember Joshua had on filthy garments; now watch what it says here. “Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH.” The BRANCH is making reference to Christ. Joshua was the high priest, and chapter 4 goes into Zerubbabel. The two kingdoms are referenced the way Christ spoke with Moses and Elijah: Zechariah makes mention of Joshua and Zerubbabel.

“And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep, And said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:” He is seeing a vision of the menorah. “And two olive trees by it,” Remember Revelation 11:4 says two olive trees and two candlesticks. “one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof. So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord? Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord. Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the Lord unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts.” So these two olive trees, these two candlesticks, make reference to Joshua the high priest and Zerubbabel, who was the governor. It goes into the law and the testimony, and it is also symbolic of the two kingdoms.

“Who art thou, O great mountain?” The great mountain, as we read later on, is talking about Babylon the great. “before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.” The headstone is the cornerstone, making reference to Christ, who is called the BRANCH in chapter 3. He shall bring it forth with shoutings, crying grace, grace, mercy, mercy unto it. “Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying, The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you. For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the Lord, which run to and fro through the whole earth.” The plummet is the measuring line. Zerubbabel laid the foundation for the building of the temple, and his hands would also finish it, which he did; when he rebuilt the temple they said it didn't compare to the glory of the original one Solomon built. This is a twofold chapter; it is also going into the last days, but that is for another lesson.

“Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof? And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?” The golden oil is going into the wisdom and knowledge of God. Notice the same analogy is given in Revelation about the two olive trees and the two candlesticks; that is why it is twofold. “And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord. All those Jehovah's Witness comic books, burn them; they are garbage, make-believe: oh, we're going to be so happy when Jesus comes; no, the Bible says you are going to be angry. Isaiah says howl ye, for the day of the Lord is at hand; that is the howling; they ain't going to be happy at all. “and thy wrath is come,” Because Christ is coming back angry. “and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great;” Where are the servants, the prophets, the saints, them that fear his name, the word of God? Judgment was given to the saints of the most High, and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom (Daniel 7:22): the judgment he gives us is power. He is going to get rid of these little raggedy bodies, these short statures, and give us power on earth as gods once again; then we are going to get the respect of these black women. I ain't going to be short no more; you might have all your hair back; my teeth are going to be straight; no more glasses. The reward is us getting the kingdom; he is going to give us power to take the earth. “and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.” Christ is going to destroy them which destroy the earth. That is some heavy stuff right there.

“And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament:” The ark Moses had was based upon what is in heaven; Paul mentioned that in the book of Hebrews, but that is for another class. “and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.” So Israel, you know what we have to do: hold the line. Sisters, can you hold the line? Brothers, can you hold the line? We better hold the line, because we are at the end of all things.

precepts.why:
This is our deliverance, what the churches call the rapture; the word rapture is Latin for caught up, taken up. The article quoted this as Hosea 2:2; it is Hosea 1:11. Read the verse before it: “Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered;” I don't care what their census says; God says we number the sand of the sea. We are the largest nation on the planet earth. “and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.” That is evidence that the real Israelites would lose their identity and gain it back in the last days. That is super heavy; where does that apply to these so-called Jews? Nowhere. That fits us. You see in the scriptures where it says ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake: nobody cares what is in the Quran, or the isms; all the nonsense in the Talmud, all that filth we just read, no big deal; but when we read things out of the Bible, all of a sudden it is an issue. Brothers and sisters, welcome to the truth; this is why we are fighting right now.

“Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head,” That is Christ. “and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.” So the deliverance is only for Judah and Israel, the two kingdoms. It is not for Baptists or Catholics or Mormons or Muslims; it is for the Israelites, Judah and Israel.

More about the rapture. “And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.” You see that: this is the great deliverance that is going to come. The angels are going to protect us; that is why we went here.

The deliverance is for anybody that believes in Jesus? No. “Thus saith the Lord God; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel” When I have gathered the house of Israel. “from the people among whom they are scattered,” From the people among whom they are scattered. “and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.” It is telling you that prior to us going to the land, we would be delivered from among the heathen where we are scattered. That is what is going to happen here.

Wisdom of Solomon; don't read it, it's not canon? Oh, shut the hell up. “Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness” That is what they are mad about; that is why they are in great fear: the righteous men are standing in great boldness. Against who? “before the face of such as have afflicted him,” Yes, they have afflicted us. “and made no account of his labours.” They have made no account of our labours; these nations. “When they see it, they shall be troubled with terrible fear,” You see that: that is what Revelation 11:11 was saying. “and shall be amazed at the strangeness of his salvation,” They are going to be amazed at the strangeness of our salvation. “so far beyond all that they looked for.” That is them chariots; that is Christ sending them chariots to deliver us from this great destruction. And it is coming.

Can you imagine this thing we see? So it is not paraphrased: “Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;” The arrow that flies by day is the ICBM missile that is going to be shot here in America. “Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.” God is telling you this final destruction is going to happen at noonday. “A thousand shall fall at thy side,” We are going to see a thousand people getting put to death on our side, “and ten thousand at thy right hand;” On our right hand we are going to see ten thousand people being incinerated. “but it shall not come nigh thee.” Why? Because them angels are going to protect us; that is why we went to Matthew 24:31. “Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.”

People often ask when it is going to happen. You see these Christians talk about seven years of tribulation, then destruction, then Jesus comes after that. No, no: the operative words we want in verse 13 are the same hour. The same hour as our deliverance is the same hour as the destruction. “Immediately after the tribulation of those days” After slavery and our mass incarceration. “shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven,” That is the satellites falling from heaven. “and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:” That means war; there is going to be war on earth between nations. “And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven:” That is when Christ is going to make his advent, as the Seventh-day Adventists say. “and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn,” The twelve tribes of Israel are going to cry when we see him. “and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory. And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.” So when are we going to be delivered? During the midst of the powers of heaven being shaken, during the midst of war, when Christ returns. That is when deliverance comes.

More evidence of when we are delivered. “Behold, the days come, when the most High will begin to deliver them that are upon the earth.” When is he going to deliver us? That is the question; it is going to tell you. “And he shall come to the astonishment of them that dwell on the earth.” That is why Christ said I am going to come like a thief in the night. “And one shall undertake to fight against another,” This is wartime. “one city against another, one place against another, one people against another, and one realm against another.” Ezra is telling you that when Christ returns it is going to be wartime, nation against nation, kingdom against kingdom; the same thing. “And the time shall be when these things shall come to pass, and the signs shall happen which I shewed thee before, and then shall my Son be declared, whom thou sawest as a man ascending.” God is telling you, then you are going to see my Son. People say Christ isn't talked about in the Apocrypha; oh, shut the hell up, you don't know what you are talking about. “And when all the people hear his voice, every man shall in their own land leave the battle they have one against another.” You see that: they are going to leave the battle they have one against another to fight Christ. That is why you see movies like Independence Day: the nations are fighting, then the aliens come and they all say we have to come together to fight the aliens; they got that from the Bible. They want all nations to come together to fight Messiah, the King of kings and Lord of lords. “And an innumerable multitude shall be gathered together, as thou sawest them, willing to come, and to overcome him by fighting. But he shall stand upon the top of the mount Sion. And Sion shall come, and shall be shewed to all men,” The sign that is going to come and be shown to all men is the twelve tribes of Israel, the elect. “being prepared and builded, like as thou sawest the hill graven without hands. And this my Son shall rebuke the wicked inventions of those nations,” He is going to rebuke the ICBM missiles, the helicopters, the jets, all those things they have created; Christ is going to knock that garbage out; their satellites are going to be garbage to him, all that false media, all that witchcraft they are using against us; the Most High is going to get rid of all of it. It is going to be a beautiful day. “which for their wicked life are fallen into the tempest; And shall lay before them their evil thoughts,” But these nations, particularly America, were Christian? It says he shall lay before them their evil thoughts, “and the torments wherewith they shall begin to be tormented, which are like unto a flame: and he shall destroy them without labour by the law which is like unto me.”

Reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; this is saying the same thing. “Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.” The time came that the saints possessed the kingdom. So what is the judgment? He is going to give us power; that is the judgment he is going to give us. He is going to get rid of these little raggedy bodies we have, these little short statures; he is going to give us power on earth as gods once again, and then we are going to get the respect of these black women over here. Bishop, I ain't going to be short no more? You ain't going to be short no more, don't worry; you might have all your hair back; my teeth are going to be straight too; you are going to be able to stay awake too; no more glasses. We are going to be as gods on earth. That is the judgment he is going to give; I love that verse right there. It is saying the same thing as Revelation 11:18: the reward is us getting the kingdom; he is going to give us power to take the earth.

sense.text:
Let's give it up for the Bishop, who brought forth this beautiful class, absolutely electrifying; we needed it in these times, and the Lord put the spirit on the Bishop to break this chapter all the way down. Now the nightcap, because of all that evil we saw up there on the screen: let this bitter glass of wine hit the evil in the head. “Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not,” All that evil we saw on the screen and in the articles, them talking all kinds of evil: Christ said, no matter what kind of lie they imagine against my anointed, against the apple of my eye, I got this. The synagogue of Satan, the house of demons; that is what these people are, a conglomerate of demons. They say they are Jews, because the Bible does not back up the lies they put on the screen about biblical scriptures; pure lies. They say anti-Semitism, anti-Semitic: the word Semitic gets its origin from the man in the Bible named Shem. Where was Esau when Shem was born? There goes your anti-Semitism right there: Esau wasn't even on the planet, so how is he going to talk about somebody being anti-Semitic when the Semites were here way before him? He is the devil the Bible speaks of; all the children that came out of Shem were known as the Semites, the Shemites. The synagogue of Satan: that is who they really are, that is their nationality, that is their name. Who is saying this? Christ. They are not the Jews; the Jews are black; Jesus Christ is a black man, the king of the Jews.

“but do lie;” What do they do? Lie. They lie in their media, they lie in their synagogues, they lie all over the place; everything they do is about lying. Didn't their Talmud say they are justified in lying? Christ is letting us know out of his words, you don't do that, and if you tell lies you are the synagogue of Satan. “behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet,” That is what you call justice. They are busy talking about what we are going to do to them: the only thing we are going to do is put our feet out and let them lick them. They are going to worship before our feet with their heads down to the earth, and they better not look up either. “and to know that I have loved thee.” He wants us to know that he loved us: all this hell we have been through, he said I am going to let the whole world know that I love you, not these bastards. That is John 3:16: the world God so loved is Israel; that is why the Most High said in Zechariah 9:6 a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, because they are not the children of God.

Earlier in Revelation 11 it talks about great fear coming upon them, and the Bishop explained that it is not the kind of fear where you shake in your boots; the fear that comes upon them is them seeing that their time is short on this earth. And that fear turns into rage: why do the heathen rage? (Psalms 2:1). That is why you see the things happening right now: the fear Edom has when they see us rising up turns into rage, and they act on it, creating laws to go against us.

precepts.why:
The fear that comes upon them turns into something. “Why do the heathen rage,” That fear turns into rage; that is why you see the things happening right now. The fear Edom has when they see us rising up turns into rage, and they start acting on that fear, creating laws to go against us. “and the people imagine a vain thing?” They are imagining a vain thing: the vain thing is all the lies being pushed out there that we are terrorists and so forth.

“The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together,” These people are counselling together; they are literally sitting down in rooms behind closed doors, and guess who is the topic of conversation: you brothers and sisters here today, online, scattered to the four corners of the earth, waking up to the truth that you are Israelites. That is what the secret council going on right now is about. “against the Lord, and against his anointed,” Who is the Lord's anointed? We are the Lord's anointed; the anointed starts first and foremost with Christ, then all of us here. “saying, Let us break their bands asunder,” This is the key thing they are trying to do: they want to destroy these Israelite groups that are rising up. “and cast away their cords from us.” The cords are the teaching of Christ; they want that to stop. That is why they are trying to label the teaching of Christ, the teachings we teach, as hate speech, and once they label it hate speech they can say you can't teach that; you set up teaching on the street and they can shut you down, saying you are teaching hate speech and can incite riot or murder. That is what they are doing.

“He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh:” You brothers and sisters have to read the scriptures; once you read them you understand everything that is going to take place. The Most High is laughing at them: you see what they are doing to my prophets? He is laughing at all the evil, the lies and the slander they are setting up against us, because the Most High has a plan; this battle we are in, the Most High is going to win for us. “the Lord shall have them in derision.” In derision, meaning confusion: you hear about impeachment, this and that happening around the world; the Most High is going to cause things to happen to remove their focus from us so we can keep doing his work. All that with the so-called impeachment of the president is the Most High doing that. So pay attention to what is going on and learn the scriptures. These classes are not to show you we know the scriptures; they are to build you up to know what is coming, so you can fight when the time comes, so when things happen you say, damn, the Bishop went over that last week; none of you in IUIC should be confused when things happen, because the Bible explains what is going to happen. The same way the Most High is laughing, you should be home laughing: look what these people are trying to do.
